templates.summary: a real call from a grandchild
templates.missCost: you'd have missed a call from family

lines.say: Hi, {address}! It's Sam.
I just wanted to say hello. I finished my exams today, and I'm so relieved.

That's all. No emergency, I promise. I just missed talking to you.
Love you lots. Talk soon, bye for now.

callback.label: Hang up and call them back myself

ivr.say: Hi, you've reached Sam. I can't pick up right now, but leave a message and I'll call you back.

templates.advice: A grandchild who just says hello is no trouble at all. It was a call to enjoy, not a call to fear.

templates.missCost: you'd have missed a real fraud alert

lines.say: Hello, is this {address}?

You don't need to do anything on this call. We will never ask you for your PIN or a code.

Thank you, and have a good afternoon.

callback.label: Hang up and call the number on my card

ivr.say: Thank you for calling {org}. Yes, we did place a precautionary hold on your card today. Nothing else is needed from you.

templates.advice: The real fraud team asked for nothing and told you to call the number on your card. That is the safe habit.

lines.say: Hello, is this {address}?

Your account has been compromised, and we need to act quickly.
Someone is trying to move your savings right now. Please stay on the line, and don't hang up, or the account locks.

I understand. This is a fraud alert on your account, and it can't wait.

callback.label: Hang up and call the number on my card

templates.advice: A real bank never asks you to read out a code. Hang up and call the number on the back of your card.

lines.say: Good afternoon, {address}.
This is Mr. Pruitt with the security team at {org}.

callback.label: Hang up and call the number on my card

ivr.say: Thank you for calling {org}. We have no security case on your account. We never ask you to move money to keep it safe.

templates.advice: No bank asks you to withdraw cash and put it in a machine. Hang up and call the number on your card.

lines.say: {address}? It's me. Please don't hang up.
I'm in trouble. I was in a car accident, and the police arrested me.
Please don't tell Mom or Dad. I'm so embarrassed.

lines.speaker: Attorney Ellison

lines.speaker: Attorney Ellison

callback.label: Hang up and call them back myself

ivr.say: The person you are trying to reach is not available. Please try again later.

templates.advice: If a family member is in trouble, hang up and call them on the number you already have. Never pay with gift cards.

ivr.say: Thank you for calling the tax helpline. No arrest warrant has been issued, and we never take payment by gift card.
